mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a skilled potter, a drunkard, a debtor and an irresponsible and careless creature (Morakinyo 1983: 78)."
Ajala is a skilled potter, a drunkard, a debtor and an irresponsible and careless creature (Morakinyo 1983: 78).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an internal imperative of doing good and avoiding evil."
Duty is an internal imperative of doing good and avoiding evil.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered to be equally fundamental, entirely independent and mutually irreducible."
Mind and matter are considered to be equally fundamental, entirely independent and mutually irreducible.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the view that God exists and does intervene in history and the truths of the Christian religion are acceptable only by faith and not reason."
Fideism is the view that God exists and does intervene in history and the truths of the Christian religion are acceptable only by faith and not reason.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ontological inquiry into the "Sein", "being", "to be" of all that there is: why there are essences."
Metaphysics for Martin Heidegger is the ontological inquiry into the "Sein", "being", "to be" of all that there is: why there are essences.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the essence put into reality, the realization of the essential, real or concrete being."
Existence is the essence put into reality, the realization of the essential, real or concrete being.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a necessary a priori representation which underlies all outer intuitions c)."
Space is a necessary a priori representation which underlies all outer intuitions c).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the view that there is a reality independent of the mind and independent of conscious beings."
Realism as presented is the view that there is a reality independent of the mind and independent of conscious beings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the science of being, its attributes, its principles and its categories."
Metaphysics is the science of being, its attributes, its principles and its categories.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered anything that exists materially or immaterially and so it remains the project and focus of ontology today to explain the nature of what there is in reality."
Being is considered anything that exists materially or immaterially and so it remains the project and focus of ontology today to explain the nature of what there is in reality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered as the living individual with its needs and interests and capacities for feeling, thinking, and creative imagination."
The self is considered as the living individual with its needs and interests and capacities for feeling, thinking, and creative imagination.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the belief in one and indivisible God."
Monotheism is the belief in one and indivisible God.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the 'what' of a thing or being while existence is the act of being exercised by beings."
Essence simply means the 'what' of a thing or being while existence is the act of being exercised by beings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a species of pantheism, accepts God's existence, but relates him reciprocally to creatures."
Panentheism is a species of pantheism, accepts God's existence, but relates him reciprocally to creatures.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered to be the capstone of philosophy such that when philosophy is emptied of metaphysics, it renders it very barren."
Little wonder metaphysics is considered to be the capstone of philosophy such that when philosophy is emptied of metaphysics, it renders it very barren.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the view that God exists but he has no more sustaining influence nor does he again care for what is happening to the world he originally created."
Deism is the view that God exists but he has no more sustaining influence nor does he again care for what is happening to the world he originally created.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a view held by "those who think you can account for universal terms without invoking universals either as real things out there in the world or as concepts in the mind…" (Moore & Bruder, 2011:87)."

Nominalism as hinted earlier is a view held by "those who think you can account for universal terms without invoking universals either as real things out there in the world or as concepts in the mind…" (Moore & Bruder, 2011:87).
